grokbot.title: Coming from Grok Bot — BipAgents
grokbot.description: Bring your Bot to BipAgents: one message pasted into Grok Bot makes it write its memory, its rules, its routines and its skills into a zip that the app imports.

grokbot.title: Coming from Grok Bot.
grokbot.sub: Grok Bot has no export button. So we ask your Bot to write everything out itself: its role, what it knows about you, the people, the tasks, its routines and its skills. Works with ChatGPT, Muse or another agent too.
grokbot.step1: One message, to paste as it is.
grokbot.step2: In your Bot’s conversation (one Bot at a time). It writes its files, then gives you bipagents-export.zip: download it.
grokbot.step3: Add an agent › Coming from another assistant › Import the file, and pick the zip. You see everything that will be created before you confirm.
grokbot.safe1: Nothing is saved before you have read it and ticked it.
grokbot.safe2: Its skills arrive switched off, its routines wait for your yes.
grokbot.safe3: Anything that looks like a password, a key or a card number is taken out.
grokbot.safe4: What your Bot writes is its own version of its memory: it may be incomplete.
